rules.name: Order Minimum Value Enforcement
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be submitted if the total calculated value of selected items is less than the minimum order value defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
exceptions: Customer applies a valid promotional coupon that covers the shortfall, if business policy allows
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected with an error message indicating the minimum order value requirement
rules.rationale: To ensure economic viability of small orders and cover operational costs for the store partner

parameters.name: minimum_order_value
parameters.description: The lowest total monetary value allowed for an order

rules.name: Expiry Risk Order Rejection
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be created if it contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry' in the primary fulfillment source.
rules.condition: during Order Request creation and validation
exceptions: Customer explicitly opts-in to purchase 'nearing expiry' items at a discounted rate, if configured
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected to prevent waste and quality issues
rules.rationale: To maintain product quality standards and minimize food waste from selling items close to expiration

parameters.name: expiry_threshold_days
parameters.description: The number of days remaining before an item is flagged as nearing expiry

rules.name: Stock Lock Release Timing
rules.statement: Locked stock associated with an Order Request must be automatically released if the Order Request remains unconfirmed within the allocated time window.
rules.condition: after the allocated confirmation time window expires
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for exceptional circumstances
rules.if_violated: The stock is freed for other customers, potentially causing the original order to be fulfilled late or cancelled
rules.rationale: To prevent inventory hoarding and ensure fair access to stock for all customers

parameters.name: allocation_time_window
parameters.description: The maximum duration an Order Request can hold locked stock before auto-release

rules.name: Dispute Ticket Linkage Integrity
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must remain linked to the original Order Request for the entire duration of the dispute resolution process.
rules.condition: during the lifecycle of a Dispute Ticket
rules.if_violated: The Dispute Ticket becomes orphaned, preventing accurate tracking of resolution against the specific order
rules.rationale: To ensure auditability and accurate financial settlement by tying disputes to the specific transaction

parameters.name: resolution_duration
parameters.description: The expected timeframe for resolving a dispute
